entry.name: statePath
entry.label: Path to the JSON written by dimm-mce-export

entry.name: pollSeconds
entry.label: How often to re-read the state file

entry.name: notifyEnabled
entry.label: Notify when new corrected errors appear

entry.name: notifyThreshold
entry.label: Only notify once this many new corrected errors have accumulated

entry.name: notifyUncorrectable
entry.label: Always notify immediately on uncorrectable errors, ignoring the quiet period

entry.name: hideWhenClean
entry.label: Keep the tray icon hidden while no errors are recorded

entry.name: badgeWindow
entry.label: Which count the tray icon and badge reflect: ce_24h, ce_7d, ce_30d or ce_total

entry.name: boardProfilePath
entry.label: Board profile JSON; empty means auto-detect from DMI

entry.name: showBoardImage
entry.label: Draw the board photo behind the slot overlay when a profile provides one

entry.name: lastSeen
entry.label: Internal: JSON map of slot key to last-notified counts

entry.name: baselineCommitted
entry.label: Internal: whether a baseline has ever been stored. Distinguishes a genuinely fresh install from configuration that has not finished loading.

entry.name: lastNotifyEpoch
entry.label: Internal: epoch seconds of the last corrected-error notification
